title: gradle test: unknown coupon code fails PricingTest with a NullPointerException
body:
`Pricing.applyCoupon` should leave the amount alone when the coupon code
is not in the map. Instead `gradle test` fails.

```bash
gradle --no-daemon test
```

```
> Task :test FAILED

PricingTest > unknownCouponIsIgnored() FAILED
    java.lang.NullPointerException at PricingTest.java:22

2 tests completed, 1 failed

FAILURE: Build failed with an exception.

* What went wrong:
Execution failed for task ':test'.
> There were failing tests. See the report at: file:///home/dana/gradleshop/build/reports/tests/test/index.html

BUILD FAILED in 8s
3 actionable tasks: 3 executed
```

This is Gradle 9.7.1 with JUnit 5. Note that Gradle prints no stack trace
by default, so the report above is all the detail the console gives.
